question.text: In chromatography technique, the purification of a compound is independent of:

options.text: Mobility or flow of solvent system
Length of the column or <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>TLC</mi></math> Plate
Physical state of the pure compound

solution.text: In chromatography technique, the purification of a compound is independent of the physical state of the pure compound.
